title: The second moment of twisted modular $L$-functions and Dirichlet $L$-functions at the central point
summary: We prove an asymptotic formula with a power-saving error term for the second moment $$ \sum_{q \in \mathcal{Q}} \; \; \sideset{}{^\flat}\sum_{χ\bmod q} \left| L\big( \tfrac{1}{2} , χ\big) L\big(\tfrac{1}{2},f\otimes χ)\right|^2 $$ of the twisted ${\rm GL}(2)$ {$L$}-function and the Dirichlet {$L$}-function at the central point under the assumption of Selberg's eigenvalue conjecture.
